svg.title: Snapper Rootbeds — Rigging spool rootbeds
svg.desc: Raised rescue platforms sit beside each snapper column. A leaning root and two rigging spools become jump steps; a broad canopy return bypasses the ambush lanes. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

spools become jump steps; a broad canopy return bypasses the ambush lanes.
